name: sketch_on_screen
description: Draw and animate a real picture of anything, in any subject, on the student's screen in one framed scene, not just a diagram: a map with routes, a market with goods and money flowing, a circuit, a pendulum, a network sending packets, a graph shifting, a cell, a molecule, a battle formation, a sentence's structure. Build it like a whiteboard artist: soft filled shapes for the objects (shape, ellipse with fill), thick curves for fibres and vessels (width), then make it live: 'flow' sends labelled particles along a path forever (goods, money, people, data packets, water, electrons, ions), 'pulse' runs a travelling glow along a path (a signal, a wave, a shock, current, a nerve impulse), and any element can glide to a new place after it is drawn (moveTo). Elements draw by hand in build steps (step 1, 2, 3...) with one caption per step. size 'large' for a rich scene. Optionally sit beside a screen region (near). Out-of-range values are clamped, so always try. Never announce it (no "Let me draw", "I'll sketch", "Let's look at"); talk about the subject while it appears.

items.description: One element. Coordinates are [x,y] on a 100x70 canvas, y down.

type.description: Element kind. shape: closed smooth outline through points (cell body, organ, membrane patch). ellipse: at + rx/ry. flow: particles moving along path forever. pulse: travelling glow along path.

points.description: curve points 2-24, or shape outline points (3+, it closes itself).

at.description: circle centre, box top-left, dot or text position [x,y].

text.description: text element content, up to 60 characters.

dashed.description: Dashed stroke (e.g. a resultant or guide line).

step.description: Build step 1-8 this element appears in; the scene pauses between steps. Omit for step 1.

moveTo.description: Optional [x,y]: after drawing, glide the element so its start point lands here (animation).

path.description: flow/pulse route, 2-40 points [x,y]; particles or the glow travel from first to last.

fill.description: Soft fill for shape, ellipse, circle or box.

width.description: Stroke width 0.3-6 (default 0.7); 2-4 for an axon, vessel or wire.

symbol.description: flow: text inside each particle, up to 4 characters, e.g. Na+, K+, e-, O2.

seconds.description: flow: seconds for one trip (default 3). pulse: seconds per sweep (default 2).

near.description: Optional regionId from the screen map to sit beside.

captions.description: Optional caption per step, shown under the scene as it plays (up to 120 characters each).

size.description: large for a detailed scene (neuron, heart, cell); default normal.
